interpretation: Quick runs test execution only and must not be used to rank samplers.
Smaller runs are exploratory: 20 chains/method, 2 seconds/chain, one seed batch and one fitted map per target/VI setting.
The t3 mean/norm errors lack fourth-moment guarantees; empirical MSE variation is descriptive and reference error remains separate.
Numba-versus-author-JAX timing includes implementation and output-processing differences.
No universal dominance, full-paper result or remote Windows/Linux pass is claimed by this local record.
